profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: I help design and create beautiful and useful web and mobile apps.  I have extensive experience in User Interface and User Experience development.  I have build several Apps for the Apple App Store, including "Show Tracker!". I have also consulted for several other projects.

positions.title: UI/UX Lead | Senior Engineer
positions.description: Develop software solutions for Cloud Services.

positions.title: Building Manager
positions.description:
Opening and closing the building.
Ensure all rooms are set up for event meetings.
Coordinate with A/V Tech Manager and House Crew Manager to ensure the accuracy and completion of event sets.
Handling crises/emergencies and utilizing staff based on their prior experience and training

positions.title: Staff Sergeant
positions.description:
Inspect aircraft hydraulic systems and components.
Performs maintenance on aircraft hydraulic systems.
Troubleshoots, removes, repairs, overhauls, replaces, adjusts, and tests malfunctioning components.
Inspecting and updating Technical Orders.
Managing over $750,000 worth of bench stock inventory.
Keeping daily logs of all maintenance.

positions.title: Telemarketer
positions.description: Sold long distance phone plans to people who were having dinner.

positions.description:
Created beautifully stacked burgers.
Promoted to Fry Manager within weeks of working there.
